studentIndependentPrompt: Draw a straight angle and partition it into 40°, x°, and x°. Label the rays, explain why 40+x+x=180, solve for x, then check with a protractor. Draw intersecting lines where an angle of 70° is opposite (3y+10)°; write an equation, solve y, and explain why the angles are equal. Exchange an original problem card and a separate data card with a partner, ask for relevant missing conditions without revealing full cards, and document the question-and-reason exchange.

criteria.description: Construct an original accurate, labeled straight-angle partition with all three parts and solve 40+x+x=180.
Draw genuine intersecting straight lines, identify the opposite vertical angles and solve 3y+10=70 with a justified equality.
Explain why each diagram entails its equation, independently measure or check the angle totals and reject mismatched geometry.
In an original information-gap activity, ask for necessary data, justify the requests, independently solve and discuss corrections with a partner.
